name: stage3d
title: Stage3d: the three.js tier
description: The lazy three.js tier (decision 0017): loadThree() imports three only when a live 3D drawing is about to be seen, and resolves null if it cannot; webglAvailable(), liteDevice() and watchVisible() choose and pause the tier; the pure core chooses live, 2D or still, reprojects a photo with a depth map so a moving camera gives true parallax, and fits it to any frame. Needs the npm package three at exactly 0.186.1.

budget.reason: Decision 0017: the tier is budgeted apart from the dependency-free layers. Today 10.0 KB: stage3d.js 4.3 KB (lazy loader, WebGL and software-renderer detection, visibility), stage3d.core.js 5.8 KB (pure, tested in Node). three itself (npmDependencies) is recorded per story as bundled.
